scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.format: biome format --write package.json biome.json playwright.config.ts tests/e2e tests/rls tests/security scripts/supabase-typegen.mjs scripts/rls-smoke.mjs scripts/rls-anon-rest-probe.mjs scripts/e2e-auth-states.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/rateLimit.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/inviteCode.mjs
scripts.format:check: biome format package.json biome.json playwright.config.ts tests/e2e tests/rls tests/security scripts/supabase-typegen.mjs scripts/rls-smoke.mjs scripts/rls-anon-rest-probe.mjs scripts/e2e-auth-states.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/rateLimit.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/inviteCode.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check package.json biome.json playwright.config.ts tests/e2e tests/rls tests/security scripts/supabase-typegen.mjs scripts/rls-smoke.mjs scripts/rls-anon-rest-probe.mjs scripts/e2e-auth-states.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/rateLimit.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/inviteCode.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
